briefdescription.para: Mask for AXI device type bits in the base address.
Sets the MAC addresses in the frame.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the frame.

briefdescription.para: Sets the frame type for the specified frame.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the frame.
is the Type to set in frame.

briefdescription.para: Places an incrementing pattern in the payload section of a frame.

detaileddescription.para: The pattern is an 8-bit incrementing series of numbers starting with 0. Once the pattern reaches 256, then the pattern changes to a 16 bit incrementing pattern: 0, 1, 2, ... 254, 255, 00, 00, 00, 01, 00, 02, ..

parameterdescription.para: is a pointer to the frame to change.
is the number of bytes in the payload that will be. set.

briefdescription.para: Verifies frame data against a CheckFrame.

detaileddescription.para: Validation occurs by comparing the ActualFrame to the header of the CheckFrame. If the headers match, then the payload of ActualFrame is verified for the same pattern Util_FrameSetPayloadData() generates.

parameterdescription.para: is a pointer to a frame containing the 14 byte header. that should be present in the ActualFrame parameter.
is a pointer to a frame to validate.

briefdescription.para: Sets all bytes of a frame to 0.

parameterdescription.para: is a pointer to the frame itself.

briefdescription.para: Sets 10G Ethernet in local loopback mode.

parameterdescription.para: is a pointer to the instance of the. XxvEthernet component.

simplesect.para:
- XST_SUCCESS if successful.
XST_FAILURE, in case of failure.

briefdescription.para: Reports an error detected by example code.

detaileddescription.para: It can be set as a breakpoint with a debugger or used to print the given message if a UART or STDIO device is present.

parameterdescription.para: is the text explaining the error.

briefdescription.para: Sets up USXGMII at the specified speed with autonegotiation enabled.

detaileddescription.para: Autonegotiation is enabled with the selected settings. If autonegotiation fails, it is restarted after a timeout. The function returns success after autonegotiation is completed. Enables RX and performs a GT reset first because USXGMII requires the same.

parameterdescription.para: is a pointer to the instance of the. XxvEthernet component.
Line rate to set. Use RATE_1G or RATE_2G5.
Set to 1 for full duplex, or 0 for half duplex.

simplesect.para:
- XST_SUCCESS if successful.
XST_FAILURE, in case of failure.

briefdescription.para: Sets up USXGMII at the specified speed with autonegotiation bypassed.

detaileddescription.para: Autonegotiation is bypassed and the status is checked for completion before returning successfully. Enables RX and performs a GT reset first because USXGMII requires the same.

parameterdescription.para: is a pointer to the instance of the. XxvEthernet component.
Line rate to set. Use RATE_1G or RATE_2G5.
Set to 1 for full duplex, or 0 for half duplex.

simplesect.para:
- XST_SUCCESS if successful.
XST_FAILURE, in case of failure.
